items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 21.11.2026. The period 'X Tage nach Rechnungsdatum' begins on the day after the triggering event per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, so counting starts 22.11.2026. 14 days later, the period ends on 05.12.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB). 05.12.2026 is a Saturday. Under § 193 BGB, if the last day of a period for a declaration or performance falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period ends on the next working day. The next working day is Monday, 07.12.2026 (no NRW public holiday falls between).
